items.docs: Returns all clusters within the specified account and project. Each cluster entry includes configuration, state, cloud provider, region placement, and endpoint information.

items.docs: Creates a new YugabyteDB Aeon cluster within the specified account and project. The request body defines the cluster name, cloud provider, region, tier, node configuration, and fault tolerance level.

items.docs: Permanently deletes the specified cluster and all its data. This operation is irreversible. All backups associated with the cluster are also deleted.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the YugabyteDB Aeon account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project within the account.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: The unique identifier of the cluster.

items.docs: Pauses a running cluster to suspend compute billing while retaining all data and configuration. The cluster can be resumed at any time. Only clusters in the ACTIVE state can be paused.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the YugabyteDB Aeon account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project within the account.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: The unique identifier of the cluster.

items.docs: Resumes a previously paused cluster, restoring it to the ACTIVE state and resuming compute billing. The cluster restores all data and configuration from before the pause.
